title: Pharmacy Retrospective Data Extraction Tool for AI-Supported Antimicrobial Stewardship in Rwandan Primary Healthcare
description: Patient-level extraction of antimicrobial dispensing records from participating pharmacies (2020–2026). Form version AMS-PHARMACY-EXTRACTION-v1.0, derived from AMS-MR-EXTRACTION-v3.0. Record only what is documented in the pharmacy's routine records; do not infer missing clinical information.
completedHtml:
Thank you.

The pharmacy data extraction form has been submitted.

pages.name: data_source
pages.title: A. Data Source and Record Identification
pages.description: Pharmacy data-source category. All variables must reflect what is documented in the pharmacy's routine records.

elements.name: data_sources
elements.title: What is the source of the information?

elements.name: pharmacy_facility_code
elements.title: Pharmacy name (select from approved facility list)

choices.text: GAS-BCP-PH — Bella Care Pharmacy (Gasabo, Private Private Pharmacy)
GAS-NGA-PH — Ngabo Pharmacy (Gasabo, Private Private Pharmacy)
BUG-ESP-PH — Emma Sanitas Pharmacy LTD (Bugesera, Private Private Pharmacy)
BUG-TGP-PH — The Guardian Pharmacy (Bugesera, Private Private Pharmacy)
GAK-MUS-PH — Pharmacy Musasa Ltd (Gakenke, Private Private Pharmacy)
GAK-SUC-PH — Success Pharmacy Ltd (Gakenke, Private Private Pharmacy)

elements.name: dispensing_date
elements.title: Date of dispensing or pharmacy visit

elements.name: study_record_id
elements.title: Unique anonymized study record ID
elements.description: Enter the study record ID assigned by the study system.

elements.name: pharmacy_source_record_reference
elements.title: Pharmacy source-record reference, where available
elements.description: Register page/line, invoice or electronic transaction number.

elements.name: patient_medical_record_id
elements.title: Patient medical-record number, where available
elements.description: Restricted identifier: stored separately from the anonymized research dataset and used only for approved record linkage.

pages.name: patient_demographics
pages.title: B. Patient Demographics
pages.description: Extract only what is documented. Select "Not documented" when a variable is absent from the pharmacy record.

elements.name: age_documentation
elements.title: How is the patient's age documented?

elements.name: gender_other
elements.title: Sex / gender as written in the record

elements.name: patient_residence_location_note
elements.html:
Patient residence location
Select the documented levels from Province down to Village. Leave lower levels blank if they are not documented.

elements.name: prescription_documented
elements.title: C1. Is there documentation of a prescription presented or received for this dispensing encounter?

elements.name: prescription_indication_text
elements.title: Clinical indication / diagnosis as written on the prescription

elements.name: encounter_reason_documented
elements.title: Documented reason for the pharmacy encounter, where available
elements.description: Record as written. Leave blank if no reason is documented.

elements.name: antimicrobial_dispensed
elements.title: C2. Was at least one antimicrobial dispensed?

pages.name: dispensing_details
pages.title: D. Antimicrobial Dispensing Details
pages.description: Record each antimicrobial dispensed separately. Leave optional fields blank when they are not documented.

choices.text: Ascorbic acid/metamizole sodium/penicillin g /streptomycin (AWaRe: Not recommended)

choices.value: Antimicrobial not found in standardised list
choices.text: Antimicrobial not found in standardised list

templateElements.name: standardized_name_other
templateElements.title: Antimicrobial not in the list — please specify

templateElements.name: duration_days
templateElements.title: Prescribed duration in days, if documented

templateElements.name: indication_documented
templateElements.title: Indication or clinical condition as documented
templateElements.description: Leave blank if not documented. Do not infer.

choices.text: Urinary: Urinary tract infection, site and agent not specified
Gastrointestinal: Infectious gastroenteritis or colitis without specification of infectious agent
General/Systemic: Bacterial infection of unspecified site
Skin/Soft tissue: Bacterial cellulitis, erysipelas or lymphangitis
Skin/Soft tissue: Deep bacterial folliculitis or pyogenic abscess of skin
Skin/Soft tissue: Other specified pyogenic bacterial infection of skin and subcutaneous tissue

templateElements.name: amount_paid_rwf
templateElements.title: Amount paid by the patient (RWF), if routinely recorded

templateElements.name: dispensing_issues
templateElements.title: Documented partial dispensing, substitution or unavailability
choices: Partial dispensing (less than the prescribed quantity)

templateElements.name: dispensing_issues_details
templateElements.title: Details as documented
templateElements.visibleIf: {panel.dispensing_issues} anyof ["Partial dispensing (less than the prescribed quantity)", "Substitution with another product", "Antimicrobial unavailable / out of stock"]

elements.name: other_medications_documented
elements.title: E1. Were other non-antimicrobial medications prescribed or dispensed during this encounter?

elements.name: other_medications_note
elements.html: <small>Do not assume that every prescribed medication was dispensed. Record the documented status of each medication.</small>

elements.name: previous_antimicrobial_use
elements.title: F1. Is there documentation that the patient used or obtained another antimicrobial within the 30 days preceding this pharmacy encounter?

elements.name: previous_use_note
elements.html: <small>Do not count the antimicrobial dispensed during the current encounter as previous use.</small>

elements.name: previous_antimicrobials
elements.title: Previous antimicrobials (within 30 days before this encounter)

choices.text: Ascorbic acid/metamizole sodium/penicillin g /streptomycin (AWaRe: Not recommended)

choices.value: Antimicrobial not found in standardised list
choices.text: Antimicrobial not found in standardised list

templateElements.name: standardized_name_other
templateElements.title: Antimicrobial not in the list — please specify

templateElements.name: approximate_date
templateElements.title: Approximate date of use or acquisition

elements.name: record_completeness
elements.title: Record completeness status
choices: Partially complete — some variables not documented

elements.name: missing_information_sections
elements.title: Which information was missing from the source record?
elements.visibleIf: {record_completeness} notempty and {record_completeness} != 'Complete — all applicable variables documented'

elements.name: missing_information_details
elements.title: Details of missing information
elements.visibleIf: {record_completeness} notempty and {record_completeness} != 'Complete — all applicable variables documented'

elements.title: Duplicate-record check against previously extracted records

elements.name: duplicate_study_record_id
elements.title: Study record ID of the possible duplicate
